entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter used in NAS security procedures to prevent replay attacks. It increments with each NAS message and wraps around after reaching its maximum value.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function, responsible for NAS security context management and NAS COUNT monitoring.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment, maintains NAS COUNT and follows procedures for NAS COUNT wrap around handling.

entities.name: Primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure that establishes a new 5G NAS security context and resets NAS COUNT to 0.

entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context containing keys and parameters for NAS message protection, including NAS COUNT.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Procedure to release the NAS signalling connection when NAS COUNT wraps around without new security context.

entities.name: ngKSI deletion
entities.description: UE action to delete the ngKSI indicating the current 5G NAS security context before sending next uplink NAS message.

entities.name: 5G-IA0 used as NAS integrity algorithm
entities.description: Condition where null integrity algorithm 5G-IA0 is used, allowing NAS COUNT wrap around without security context change.

relations.description: AMF initiates primary authentication when NAS COUNT is close to wrap around and no suitable non-current security context exists.
Primary authentication establishes a new 5G NAS security context.
New security context activation resets NAS COUNT to 0 in both UE and AMF.
UE releases NAS signalling connection if NAS COUNT wraps around without new KAMF.
UE deletes ngKSI before sending next uplink NAS message after NAS COUNT wrap around.
When 5G-IA0 is used, current NAS security context continues to be used after NAS COUNT wrap around.
AMF shall not initiate primary authentication when 5G-IA0 is used and NAS COUNT wraps around.
NAS signalling connection shall not be released when 5G-IA0 is used and NAS COUNT wraps around.
